items.claim: Navajo Sterling previously played it too safe and avoided unnecessary risks in his fights.
items.quote: he's playing it too safe and this and that. Don't get me wrong, he's winning all these fights, but he's kind of also not taking any unnecessary risks.

items.claim: Navajo Sterling's last two performances showed a major improvement in taking risks and pursuing finishes.
items.quote: These last two performances have been a huge step in the right direction... if Navajo just took a couple more risks, if Navajo just went for the finish a little bit more... and that's exactly what he did his last two fights.

items.claim: The opponents Navajo Sterling faced in his last two fights were not on the level of Jan Blachowicz.
items.quote: the guys he fought were nowhere on the level of Yan Blahovich

items.claim: Ion Cutelaba is a hit or miss fighter.
items.quote: Iwan Coutalaba is hit or miss
